rationale: The plan correctly refuses tximport on a gene-level table, fits DESeq2 Wald (with edgeR QL as a second method) on the counts as delivered with no length offset, checks for fractional values, and carries the lost-offset/isoform-usage caveat into the report while naming quant.sf or an average-transcript-length table as the resolving input. It falls short of the reference in not stating what would change if those inputs arrived (gene-level tximport with tx2gene and the length offset) and in framing the request only as a report limitation rather than an upfront ask. QC is design-blind with PCA, distance heatmap and library sizes, with a flag-only outlier policy but no explicit shallow-sample threshold. Filter, in-model normalization, explicit relevel and contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm, and omission of enrichment are all correct and stated.
